cards.title: Configured, not benchmarked
items: MLA latent rank 128. Each MoE has 1 shared + 16 routed experts, top-2 routing.
Parameter totals and decoding throughput are not independently measured here.

cards.title: Actual forward semantics
items: src/hymo/models/model.py:HyMo and src/hymo/models/mla.py:MLABlock.forward define the repeated scope.
GDN uses RoPE in this configuration. The optional NoPE-hybrid variant is disabled.
MLA expands grouped K/V before SDPA. Fused GDN is conditional on CUDA and its flag, not a universal execution guarantee.

cards.title: Auxiliary supervision limitation
items: src/hymo/models/mtp.py:MultiTokenPrediction.forward consumes future-token embeddings plus prior hidden states.
Each head is also supervised on those future token IDs. Target/conditioning correctness needs a separate model investigation.
Dashed edges mark training auxiliary dependencies, not a certified speculative decoding path.
